method: Actual PersonalLexicon observation API plus InputCoordinator with production pack. Synthetic 511/512 unique letter-only personal entries. Target qrmenü chosen through visible literal suggestion.
finding: Explicit original choice cannot admit a new word if full lexicon contains only entries with higher points; repeated explicit choices never accumulate because each new entry is evicted immediately

conditions.how_existing_points_obtained: one weak observation then one strong observation, via public observe API

observed: Three consecutive original picks write qrmenü correctly but each leaves points0 and admittedfalse. After forgetting one old word, next pick admits qrmenü.
controls: 511 four-point entries: new word admitted immediately
512 three-point entries: oldest evicted and new word admitted
forgetPersonal removes target from both personal dictionary and engine vocabulary in all three setups
relation_to_existing_policy: Known documented full-dictionary restriction concerned weak observations; this demonstrates it also rejects explicit user selection, contrary to immediate-learning UX promise.
limitations: Constructed full dictionaries, not measured real-user frequency
